name: Kadmiel
title: Levite during the rebuilding of the temple
summary: Kadmiel was a Levite from the descendants of Hodavjah who returned from the Babylonian exile together with Zerubbabel and Joshua. He played an important role in the rebuilding of the temple in Jerusalem and led the people in worship and praise. He was also active in renewing the covenant under Ezra and Nehemiah.

keyEvents.title: Return from exile
keyEvents.description: Kadmiel and his descendants were among the Levites who returned from Babylon to Jerusalem with Zerubbabel and Joshua. The number of his clan was seventy-four Levites.

keyEvents.title: Founding of the new temple
keyEvents.description: Kadmiel and his sons actively participated in leading the work of laying the foundation for the Lord's temple, and they supervised the workers.

keyEvents.title: Leadership in praise and worship
keyEvents.description: Kadmiel was among the Levites who led the people in praise and worship during the great assembly, where they cried out to the Lord their God with a loud voice.

keyEvents.title: Confession and Prayer for the People
keyEvents.description: Kadmiel helped lead the people in a long prayer of confession as they recounted Israel's history and acknowledged their sins before God.

keyEvents.title: Sealing the Covenant
keyEvents.description: Kadmiel was among the Levites who placed their seal on the renewed covenant with God, where the people committed themselves to follow God's law and commands.

keyEvents.title: Thanksgiving Service at the Dedication of the Wall
keyEvents.description: Kadmiel's descendants participated in the praise during the dedication of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah's leadership.
